name: Cultural Landscape of Old Tea Forests of the Jingmai Mountain in Pu’er
description: On Jingmai Mountain in Yunnan, southwestern China, villages sit among ancient tea groves, ringed by forest and newer plantations. Blang and Dai communities have tended these trees beneath the forest canopy for a thousand years, since the 10th century. The leaves become Pu'er tea, and local festivals honour the Tea Ancestor, who is believed to dwell in the trees.
